{{Top|leg}}
A '''rapard''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of predator which hunted through stealth. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] compared the hunting technique of her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Saba Sebatyne]], to that of a rapard while they were on [[Tenupe]].
